caption: Table 1: IRIS AKI Grading Criteria
rows:
Nonazotemic AKI:
a. Documented AKI: (historical, clinical, laboratory, or imaging evidence of AKI, clinical oliguria/anuria, volume responsiveness‡)
b. Progressive nonazotemic increase in blood creatinine: > 0.3 mg/dL (> 26.4 μmol/l) within 48 h
c. Measured oliguria (<1 ml/kg/h) or anuria over 6h

Mild AKI:
a. Documented AKI and static or progressive azotemia
b. Progressive azotemia: increase in blood creatinine > 0.3 mg/dL (> 26.4 μmol/l) within 48 h), or volume responsiveness
c. Measured oliguria (<1 ml/kg/h) or anuria over 6h
Moderate to Severe AKI: Documented AKI and increasing severities of azotemia and functional renal failure
